reply_text:
*CRITICAL*
1. `bill/split.py:4–5` drops remainder cents: `split_bill(1000, 3)` returns `[333,333,333]`, totaling 999; splitting 2 cents three ways returns all zeros.
   *Recommended fix:* Use `divmod(total_cents, n)` and add one cent to each of the first remainder shares, as promised in `README.md:5`. Add both cases to `tests/test_split.py`; its current tests only cover exact divisions.

*INFORMATIONAL*
2. `bill/tip.py:2` converts integer money to floating point through `/`, violating the no-float contract (`README.md:3`). At large amounts it loses cents: `with_tip(9007199254740993, 100)` returns one cent less than exactly doubling the bill.
   *Recommended fix:* Calculate the tip using integer/rational arithmetic or `Decimal`, with an explicit rounding policy; add tip tests.

All 5 existing tests pass. No code changed.
